brand.name: AgroYachay
brand.long: An open-source IoT and large-language-model platform supporting agronomic and economic decision-making for Andean smallholders
brand.meaning: AgroYachay joins “agro” with yachay, Quechua for “knowledge”: knowledge for better decisions in the field.

landing.tile_crops_text: Photos and data for every crop
landing.tile_pests_note: Local vision model · your photo never leaves the server
landing.tile_weather_week: Lows and highs for the next 7 days
landing.step_measure_text: A low-cost node measures the air and soil of your field.
landing.step_understand_text: AgroYachay compares each reading with what your crop needs.
landing.step_decide_text: You get clear advice in your own language.

overview.subtitle: This is how your field is doing right now.

almanac.no_tasks: No specific tasks for this day.
almanac.legend_traditional_text: Practices linked to the moon come from Andean tradition. They are respected and shown, but they are not agronomic evidence.
almanac.legend_evidence_text: Sun times, day length and the crop calendar are computed or based on agronomic recommendations.
almanac.calendar_text: Typical stages for the Altiplano and inter-Andean valleys.
almanac.location_note: Sun times use your saved location.

onboarding.title: First steps
onboarding.text: Follow these 4 steps so AgroYachay can help you with your field.
onboarding.step_crop_text: Say what you grow and how many hectares you have.
onboarding.step_sensor_text: Use the AgroCommish app on your phone, then accept the sensor here.
onboarding.step_link: Link the sensor to your crop
onboarding.step_link_text: That way you know in which field the air and soil are measured.
onboarding.step_location: Turn on your location for the weather
onboarding.step_location_text: So the forecast is for your own place.
help.crops.intro: Here you write down each field you sow: which crop it is, how many hectares it has and when you sowed it.
help.crops.step2: Choose the crop and write the hectares.
help.crops.step3: Tap “Save”. You can change it any time.
help.devices.intro: Here you accept the sensors that measure your field and choose which crop each one is in.
help.devices.step1: Turn on the sensor and set it up with the AgroCommish app.
help.devices.step2: When it shows up under “Waiting to be claimed”, tap “Claim” and give it a name.
help.devices.step3: Choose the crop where the sensor is.
help.monitoring.intro: Here you see the temperature and humidity your sensor measures.
help.monitoring.step1: Choose your sensor at the top.
help.monitoring.step2: Read the message: green is fine; orange or red needs attention.
help.monitoring.step3: Change the period to see earlier hours or days.
help.weather.intro: Here you see today’s weather and the next 7 days for your place, with frost and rain warnings.
help.weather.step1: The first time, allow AgroYachay to use your location.
help.weather.step2: Check whether frost or rain is coming this week.
help.weather.step3: Ask for a work plan for the next days.
help.almanac.intro: Here you see the moon phases and the field tasks for each month.
help.almanac.step1: Tap a day to see the moon and the tasks.
help.almanac.step2: Use the arrows to change the month.
help.pests.intro: Here you take a photo of a sick leaf and AgroYachay tells you what it may be and how to treat it.
help.pests.step1: Tap “Take photo” or pick a photo from your phone.
help.pests.step2: Take the photo up close and in daylight.
help.pests.step3: Read the result. If in doubt, ask an agronomist.
help.inputs.intro: Here you work out how much fertiliser, seed and labour you need, and what it costs in soles.
help.inputs.step1: Choose the crop and write the hectares.
help.inputs.step3: See the products and their prices in the other tab.
help.yield.intro: Here you estimate how much you could harvest and how much money you could earn.
help.yield.step1: Choose one of your crops or type the details.
help.yield.step3: See what raises or lowers your harvest.
help.advisory.intro: Here you ask AgroYachay’s assistant or an agronomist about your field.
help.advisory.step1: Write your question in simple words.
help.advisory.step3: If you need a person, send your question to an agronomist.
help.reports.intro: Here you see a summary of your field and can download or print it.
help.reports.step1: Review the summary of your crops and sensors.
help.reports.step2: Tap a spreadsheet to download it.
help.reports.step3: Tap “Print” to have it on paper.
help.profile.intro: Here you change your name, language, location and password.
hw.section_title: Get to know your sensor node
hw.section_text: Short narrated videos that show each part of the node and what it does.
hw.audio_note: Narrated in English, with English and Spanish captions.
hw.kit_text: DHT11, soil probe, LM393 comparator and ESP32 working together.
hw.soil_text: Goes into the ground and senses how much water the soil holds.
hw.lm393_text: Turns the probe's signal into a clean reading; its knob adjusts the sensitivity.
hw.esp32_text: The brain of the node: reads the sensors and sends the data over Wi-Fi every 10 s.
hw.unavailable: This video is not available yet. Please try again later.
pests.triage_note: This is a first check, not a final diagnosis. Look at other plants and ask an agronomist before applying any product.
guide.title: Video guide
guide.intro: Twelve 20-second videos that show each part of AgroYachay, narrated in English with subtitles.
guide.note: Videos made from real screenshots of the application with demonstration data; the narration voice is synthetic.
guide.watch_all_on: Continuous play: the next video starts when this one ends.
guide.audio_note: Narrated in English with English subtitles.
guide.summary_dashboard: Shows the home screen: your crops, sensor status and today's alerts.
guide.summary_crops: Shows how to add a crop with its area, planting date and location.
guide.summary_devices: Shows how to link a sensor to its crop and give it a clear name.
guide.summary_monitoring: Shows temperature, air humidity and soil moisture over time; an alert is a reason to check the field.
guide.summary_weather: Shows the forecast to prepare for rain, frost, wind and dry spells.
guide.summary_almanac: Shows seasonal information, moon phases and the local farming calendar.
guide.summary_pests: Shows how to upload a leaf photo for a first check, which is not a final diagnosis.
guide.summary_inputs: Shows the calculator: pick crop, area and goal to get a list of materials with estimated costs.
guide.summary_harvest: Shows the harvest and income estimate and the factors that can change it.
guide.summary_advisory: Shows how to ask a question in your own words and request help from an agronomist.
guide.summary_reports: Shows the report that brings together crops, sensors, alerts and season planning.
guide.summary_profile: Shows how to change your language and field location.
